zh_TW: 第 {n} 波打完：{sec} 秒，被打中 {hits} 下

en: All waves cleared: {sec} s, hit {hits} times. Back to wave 1.
zh_TW: 全部打完：共 {sec} 秒，被打中 {hits} 下。從第一波再來

en: {n} more coming. {left} left in this wave.
zh_TW: 又來了 {n} 個。這一波還剩 {left} 個

en: Glowing red: can't be interrupted and barely feels your hits. Dodge, then hit back.
zh_TW: 他發紅了：打不斷、也打不痛。閃開，等他打完再打

en: You're poisoned, and for you that heals. Press {key} to burst it: the more seconds, the harder it hits.
zh_TW: 你中毒了——對你是回血。按 {key} 把毒炸出去：身上的毒越多秒，炸得越痛

en: Everyone else runs out. I walk in.
zh_TW: 別人往外跑，我往裡面站。

en: Smells like medicine gone bad. My kind of medicine.
zh_TW: 聞起來像壞掉的藥。剛好，我就吃這個。

en: Better than breakfast. I skipped breakfast.
zh_TW: 這口比早餐好。我今天沒吃早餐。

en: More than I can use. Share it.

zh_TW: 站這麼近，是你們自己選的。
好，剛剛那下當作沒人看到。

en: That's poison! Why are you standing in it?!
zh_TW: 那是毒！你站在裡面幹嘛！

en: Hold on. Does he look... better?
zh_TW: 等一下，他臉色怎麼變好了？

en: Did I grab the wrong bottle...?
Why did you walk back in?!
You fell. Returning to the last checkpoint…
zh_TW: 你倒下了。回到上一個檢查點……
釋放（把身上的毒炸出去）

en: If I dodge, it lands on the wounded. I'm staying.
zh_TW: 我一閃開，砸到的就是車上的傷者。我不走。

en: Sheila is down — {0}s to pull her up
zh_TW: 席菈倒下——{0} 秒內拉起

en: Sheila is down — she'll get up when it's over
zh_TW: 席菈倒下——戰鬥結束後會起來
